checkedAlternates.risk: A min-heap is commonly used to implement a priority queue.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Structurally, a binary min-heap is a tree-ordered structure (group-4), distinct from FIFO queues (group-2).
Bloom filters rely on multiple hash functions (group-3), not tree/graph pointers.
